afternoon.en: Reviewing logistical flow along main street—afternoon, {farmer}.

evening.en: Even meticulous managers unwind politely past dusk, {farmer}.

night.en: Conclude your final routes safely back to {farm}, {farmer}.
night.es: Concluye tus ultimas rutas con seguridad hacia {farm}, {farmer}.
